One main-area feature surface at a time: Files opens while closing Settings/Git/Usage/Worktrees; return-to-chat preserves the file entity. Docked Review and Explorer are mutually exclusive. Full-width Review keeps/restores a dock width and opens the sessions sidebar.
Workspace edits from agent, user, editor or Git refresh docked Review, visible Git status, Explorer, active Files tab, branch status and visible Worktrees list.
backend_only_reason: Filesystem watch invalidation and stale-response ordering are behavioral obligations. No unique screenshot proves watcher correctness.

feature: Resizable sidebar, Review, Explorer and terminal dimensions survive relaunch.
Git has six tabs: Changes, History, Graph, Stashes, Issues and Pull requests. Header/back, branch row, refresh, contextual busy/empty/error states and shortcuts invoke controllers.
Git branch/status discovery includes staged and unstaged status columns, original rename path, per-side additions/deletions, untracked counts, ahead/behind and unborn/detached conditions.
Branch picker searches and groups current/recent/local/remote refs; checkout local or create/check out a local tracking branch for remote. Recent selection is derived from HEAD reflog.

New branch, rename current branch, safe branch delete; branch merge/rebase ref picker includes local/remote/tag refs. Merge offers normal fast-forward-permitted, no-ff and squash modes. Dirty rebase uses autostash.
Changes uses grouped staged/unstaged Review sections with per-file Stage/Unstage and bulk Stage all/Unstage all; counts and action availability follow actual status.
Discard individual unstaged path or all unstaged changes through explicit confirmation; staged changes are intended to remain.
Commit bar has editable message, include-unstaged checkbox, Commit and Commit-and-push, blank-message generation, and state-driven Push/Publish/Pull/Merge/up-to-date actions.

Generate conventional commit message from staged diff, optional unstaged context, original files, branch/repo and recent repository/user commit style. Generate can ask Stage all versus use already-staged content; blank-message commit chains generation into commit.
Fetch, push/publish with upstream creation, ff-only pull, merge upstream, rebase upstream with autostash, Sync and force-with-lease. Sync fetches, pulls/merges when behind, then pushes when ahead.

Persistent copyable Git failure banner classifies push rejection/divergence/conflicts/dirty-overwrite/auth/network/no-upstream, secret scanning, file-size/LFS/protected-branch/hooks, missing remote/repository and unknown failures. Offers only matching recovery.

Detect and display in-progress merge/rebase/cherry-pick/revert/bisect, conflict count and up to eight file links. Open conflicts in Files; continue once no conflicts; skip only rebase/cherry-pick; confirm abort.
Stashes tab lists newest first; create stash including untracked, pop, apply without removal and drop.
History shows current branch commit list, optional all-refs filter, author filtering by author interaction, path/file history with follow-renames, removable filter chips and Load more.

Expand/collapse commit detail with subject/body/hash/author/committer/parents/refs and changed-file statistics; copy/open external commit links. File menu opens current file, current uncommitted diff, OS reveal, path copy or follow-renames history.
Graph draws branch lanes, merge edges, refs and commit metadata; all-refs option includes remote-only commits and Load more deepens history.
Git author avatars resolve from email-to-login override, GitHub noreply address, then handle-shaped name; fallback is stable colored initials. GitHub signed-in account chip shows current gh identity.
GitHub integration probes gh availability/auth/version and shows honest setup states on Issues/Pulls when absent or signed out. Refresh retries probe; CLI path can be overridden by `GH_BIN`.
Issue list has Open/Closed/All, search, label filter, clear filters, status/author/label/time/comment metadata and detail selection.
Issue detail renders Markdown body/comments and metadata; send comment, toggle labels, close/reopen, open on GitHub, return to list.

New issue form has title/body/notes, repository template selector and generation, submit, cancel/back. Requires nonblank title; selected template labels pass to create. Successful creation clears fields, reloads list and opens resulting issue number.

Repository issue/PR templates follow `.github/*_TEMPLATE/` directory then legacy single-file lookup. Markdown frontmatter supplies name/about/title/labels; YAML issue forms flatten to Markdown; config.yml excluded.
Pull request list has Open/Closed/Merged/All, search, clear filters, draft/author/labels/ref/diffstat/review/check summary and detail selection.
PR detail renders Markdown description, comments, reviews, commits, changed files, CI checks with links, draft/ref/state metadata and additions/deletions.
PR comment, approve/request changes, close/reopen, checkout, merge by merge/squash/rebase and optional delete-head-branch. Merge requires confirmation showing method.
New PR form has title/body/notes, draft toggle, base-branch picker, template selection, generation, submit/cancel. Base picker is anchored in form; default prefers main/master then available branch.
AI issue/PR draft uses optional user notes, branch commits/diff and chosen template; preserves template prefix/body structure.
Review can open from toolbar diffstat, transcript per-turn summary, command/palette, Git file callback; select desired file after load. Separate embedded instance supplies Changes overview.

Review sources: Last Turn, Uncommitted, Unstaged, Staged, Committed and Branch. Comparisons respectively use turn refs; HEAD→worktree; index→worktree; HEAD→index; branch base→HEAD; branch base→worktree.
Snapshot tracked and untracked files at turn start/end into session-keyed `refs/orbit/session-…` checkpoint commits; recover latest completed turn after restart and continue numbering.
Last Turn attribution handles branch switches during or between turns and dirty files on target branch; starting metadata retains HEAD, branch and repository refs.
Review parses file/hunk/section headers, added/deleted/context/meta lines, old/new line numbers, binary rows, totals and paint-only syntax. Diff/stat reads are off-thread.
Long unchanged context collapses around changes; directional expand from either edge, both edges/count, or all reveals retained lines.
Review wrap/no-wrap, unified/split diff, per-file and all-file collapse/expand, sticky file/section headers, horizontal pan with pinned header, dock resize and full-width toggle.
Changed-files tree groups folders, expands/collapses directories, case-insensitive filter, selection/highlight, jump to file and autoexpansion of new directories.

Review keyboard context: Up/Down tree cursor, Enter/Space toggle/open, n/p next/previous file, ]/[ next/previous hunk, e/c expand/collapse all, Escape returns to composer/closes Review rather than aborting agent.
Review loading starts immediately, stale invalidation reloads when visible, generation rejects older source requests, manual refresh feedback minimum 650 ms, source-specific empty/error states.
Worktrees page lists Git-discovered main/linked/external worktrees with independent name/path/branch, active/bare/detached/locked/prunable markers and reasons.

Create worktree from existing local/remote branch or a new branch with optional start point; separate editable display/directory name and branch name, auto-derived new branch until user edits it; quick-create suggests unused branch slug plus suffix.
Worktree validation rejects empty/dot/parent/separator names, root escape, existing paths, missing repo and branch conflict. Creation errors keep actionable context rather than pretending success.
Settings configure worktree root, setup-script path, run-setup automatically and open-after-create. Repository `.orbit/worktree.json` overrides root/script, not global booleans.
First setup-script run per repository requires explicit AllowSetup dialog; create dialog can disable setup for that worktree.
Setup runs after successful Git creation and before automatic opening; expandable captured stdout/stderr/exit result, success/warning toasts, retry, dismiss and manual open.

Open worktree adds workspace, persists current directory and synchronizes Review/Git/Explorer/new-terminal context; historical sessions retain their recorded workspace. Missing cold-session cwd shows unavailable dialog with locate/worktrees action, no silent substitution for a deleted directory.
Rename worktree directory under configured root or move to explicit resolved destination, preserving branch; reject blank/existing/no-op target. Active selected workspace follows moved path.
Remove worktree asks explicit clean/dirty confirmation after reading dirty state; dirty confirmation uses `--force`; branch is never deleted. Main/unknown/locked worktrees refused by backend.
Lock/unlock, prune stale administrative entries, repair metadata after manual move, reveal and copy path. Worktree row click opens; right-click and ellipsis menus share actions.
Status “Work in” picker has Local/main, linked worktrees and New; Up/Down wrap selection, Enter chooses, Escape closes/restores composer focus; mutually excludes overlapping popovers.
Worktrees refresh/busy/error/empty UI, setup banner and dismissible introductory guide. External changes trigger throttled list refresh while page visible.

Explorer scans workspace with nested/global Git ignores and `.ignore`, keeps empty directories, directories-first case-insensitive order, hidden-files toggle, Git status badges and dirty-ancestor markings, filter including matching subtree/ancestors.

Explorer virtualized rows, active-file highlight/reveal and ancestor expansion; mouse activate expands folder or opens file. Up/Down/Home/End, Left/Right folder collapse/expand, platform+Left/Right all collapse/expand, Enter/Space activate.

Explorer row context menu at pointer, viewport-flipping: folder expand/collapse, New File/Folder, Rename/Delete; file Open/Rename/Delete; both default-app open, reveal, copy absolute and relative path. Header has creation/refresh/collapse/hidden controls.
New file/folder inline name field in selected folder/root, Enter confirm/Escape cancel. File creation opens new editable tab; folder creation refreshes tree; success toast/error strip.
Rename file/folder within parent with open-tab subtree reconciliation; Delete confirms before dispatch, closes affected tabs without writing, refreshes tree.
Files has multi-tab editor, existing-tab activation preserves buffer, scrolling tab strip, close tab selects neighbor; last close exits Files. Hide preserves tabs and flushes dirty edits.

Code/text editing reuses ComposerInput with syntax paint, gutter, no wrap, fill-area layout; selection/navigation, cut/copy/paste, undo/redo, newlines and save shortcuts work in Editor context without sending chat.

Autosave 500 ms debounce flushes ALL dirty tabs; manual save does same. Status chips show saved/unsaved/saving/failed/changed-on-disk. Watch reload updates clean buffer; dirty buffer retained and conflict flag shown; self-save echo preserves caret/scroll.

Markdown rendered preview/source toggle uses live edited buffer; image preview for PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/TIFF/SVG; code/text read-only fallback for lossy/truncated content; binary/too-large/read-error honest states. Toolbar shows relative path, byte size/lines/truncation/save status.

Integrated bottom terminal owns one real alacritty PTY/shell per tab. New tab uses current workspace; old tabs keep original shells/cwd across workspace/session switch and hidden panel. Toggle focuses shell; close tab ends that shell; closing last tab closes panel.
Terminal renders real VT grid on canvas: ANSI/indexed/truecolor, attributes, wide cells, selections, cursor shapes/focus, scrollback indicator and resizing.

Terminal translates Enter/backspace/tab/shift-tab/arrows/home/end/page/insert/delete/F1–F12, application-cursor mode, C0 control keys and Alt/meta; app-platform shortcuts not sent to shell. Escape specifically goes to terminal so vim/less can exit, not global AbortRun.
backend_only_reason: PTY keyboard byte encodings and app-shortcut routing require process/input assertions, not another static screenshot.

feature: Mouse drag simple text selection, precise left-side cell boundary, copy selection and clipboard paste with bracketed-paste framing when enabled; smooth pixel/line scroll accumulator.

Terminal tabs display login-shell icon, OSC title or folder fallback, own cwd tooltip; tab strip scrolls; next/previous wrap; resize height; restart only active tab in original cwd, preserving others; exited overlay and startup error state.

Open-in discovers installed editors/terminals/file manager once off-thread with real app icons. macOS catalog VS Code/Cursor/Zed/Finder/Terminal/Termy/iTerm2/Kitty/Ghostty/Warp/Xcode/Rider/Android Studio; Windows catalog VS Code/Cursor/Zed/Explorer/Windows Terminal/Rider/Android Studio.

Split open-in control: preferred app primary action and searchable installed-app menu; selecting app opens current workspace and remembers choice. Primary fallback opening does not overwrite unavailable preference.
Open-in preference resolution: workspace-specific choice, legacy global fallback, platform file manager, then first installed app. Temporarily unavailable saved app stays remembered for reinstall.
Platform helpers reveal files, default-open paths, launch interactive external terminal commands, open browser links and find home directory.

One shell entity survives closing and reopening main window (macOS Dock reopen); main window opens maximized with screen-relative restore size/minimum 960×640. Background heartbeat continues windowless. Windows/Linux have own minimize/maximize/restore/close/drag behavior; macOS native traffic-light chrome.
Keyboard commands, menu/palette actions and UI buttons share registered actions; Git tab shortcuts are actually platform+Alt+1…6, not stale prose saying Cmd+1…6.
